item.title: Study suggests Trump’s unproven autism claims influenced care
item.description: "It just shows that in our country right now, health care has been politicized in a way that political messages are driving and impacting care — and not always for good," said Dr. Susan Sirota, a pediatrician in Highland Park, Illinois, who wasn't involved with the research.

item.title: This weekend’s US clock change is a problem, and there’s a deep divide on how to fix it
item.description: "There's no law we can pass to move the sun to our will," said Jay Pea, the president of Save Standard Time, an organization devoted to switching to standard time for good.

item.title: Gwyneth Paltrow and Robert Downey Jr. added to Oscars presenter lineup
item.description: The Academy Awards will be held on Sunday, March 15, at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles. The show, to be broadcast live by ABC, is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. Eastern/4 p.m. Pacific.

item.title: Peter Jackson to receive honorary Palme d’Or at Cannes Film Festival
item.description: "This festival has always celebrated bold, visionary cinema, and I'm incredibly grateful to the Festival de Cannes for being recognized among the filmmakers and the artists whose work continues to inspire me," Jackson said.

item.description: Nominees: "Bugonia"; "F1"; "Frankenstein"; "Hamnet"; "Marty Supreme"; "One Battle After Another"; "The Secret Agent"; "Sentimental Value"; "Sinners"; "Train Dreams"

item.title: Boys Basketball: Grandview falls short of another upset with loss to Rock Canyon in 6A Great 8
item.description: The Grandview boys basketball team had its season come to an end at the Denver Coliseum Friday morning, as the 13th-seeded Wolves fell to No. 5 Rock Canyon 66-52.

item.title: PERRY: Trump Regrettment Syndrome gets a 1-hour reprieve with daylight savings time
item.description: 'In the giant encyclopedia of incredibly stupid things humans have inflicted on themselves and the planet, which boasts such notable feats Congressperson Lauren Boebert and cappuccino-flavored potato chips, daylight saving time rises to the top of the list of heinous gaffes'

item.title: Evidence suggests the deadly blast at an Iranian school was likely a US airstrike
item.description: International law experts condemn the strike as a violation of armed conflict rules.

item.title: Boys Basketball: Rangeview finally gets going, downs Cherry Creek to earn return to 6A Final Four
item.description: The Rangeview boys basketball team finally found its rhythm in the second half Friday afternoon and went on to a 51-33 win over Cherry Creek to make next week's Class 6A boys Final Four.
